title: Number of users
task: Set result to the number of rows in users.

title: Stream columns
context: What does a watch event record?
task: Set result to the list of column names of streams.

title: Premium users
task: Set result to the users rows where plan == 'Premium'.

title: Premium count
task: Set result to the number of users with plan 'Premium' (an int).

title: Users per plan
task: Set result to a Series of user counts per plan (value_counts).

title: Users per country
task: Set result to a Series of user counts per country.

title: Total minutes watched
task: Set result to the sum of minutes_watched across all streams (an int; blanks ignored).

title: Average minutes per stream
task: Set result to the mean minutes_watched rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Completed streams
context: How many watched to the end?
task: Set result to the number of streams with completed == 1 (an int).

title: Completion rate
task: Set result to the completion rate (mean of completed) as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal.

title: Title and genre
task: Set result to a DataFrame with just title and genre from titles.

title: Movies only
task: Set result to the titles rows where kind == 'Movie'.

title: Titles per genre
task: Set result to a Series of title counts per genre, sorted descending.

title: Streams per device
task: Set result to a Series of stream counts per device.

title: Streams per user
task: Set result to a Series of stream counts per user_id (groupby size).

title: Minutes per device
task: Set result to a Series of total minutes_watched per device, sorted descending.

title: Longest movies
task: Set result to the 5 movies with the longest runtime_min (title, runtime_min), sorted descending.

title: Watch year
task: Set result to streams with an added column watch_year = year of watch_date.

title: Streams in 2025
task: Set result to the number of streams with watch_date year 2025 (an int).

title: Watch hours
task: Set result to streams with a column hours = minutes_watched / 60 rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Kids flag
task: Set result to titles with a column is_kids = 1 if genre == 'Kids' else 0.

title: Distinct titles watched
task: Set result to the number of distinct title_id values in streams (an int).

title: Oldest release year
task: Set result to the minimum release_year in titles (an int).

title: Recent titles
task: Set result to the titles rows with release_year >= 2022.

title: Total revenue
task: Set result to the sum of amount in subscriptions (an int).

title: Revenue per plan
task: Set result to a Series of total amount per plan, sorted descending.

title: Long sessions
task: Set result to the number of streams with minutes_watched > 60 (an int).

title: Two conditions
task: Set result to users with plan 'Premium' and country 'India'.

title: Average age
task: Set result to the mean user age rounded to 1 decimal.

title: Completion by device
task: Set result to a Series of mean completed per device (2 dp).

title: Missing minutes
task: Set result to the number of streams with a missing minutes_watched (an int).

title: Streams per month
task: Set result to a Series of stream counts per month ('YYYY-MM' strings), sorted by month.

title: Genre initial
task: Set result to a Series of the first letter of each title's genre.

title: Runtime in hours
task: Set result to titles with a column runtime_hours = runtime_min / 60 rounded to 2 decimals.
